verdicts.quote: Creation is atomic: the store afterwards holds either all N new users or none, even on a failure partway through.
all errors in a readable list or table (row, line, column, message)

EMAIL_EXISTS | normalized email already belongs to a user … DUPLICATE_IN_FILE | normalized email already appeared in an earlier row; the first occurrence is not flagged, and the error names the first row
The CSV may assign only non-privileged roles. Initially the only such role is `member`; `admin` is rejected with ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED.
verdicts.missing: The fixed role list prevents elevation in the two-role model. The spec gives no rule comparing a requested role with the particular importer's grant authority.

verdicts.quote: the import screen and the import operation are available only to an authenticated user who is currently an admin.
verdicts.missing: The spec does not define how single-user creation rights relate to import authorization or explicitly say that holding the former alone grants no bulk access.

verdicts.quote: The first record is the header. … columns are `email` (required), `name` (required) and `role` (optional). … Any header error rejects the whole file … MISSING_COLUMN | a required column is absent … UNKNOWN_COLUMN | any other header name
quoted fields may contain commas and line breaks … Accepted encoding is UTF-8, with or without a leading byte-order mark. Line endings may be LF or CRLF.
no partial effects of any kind survive a rejected or failed import: no user, no role grant, no pending invite. … Import sends no email and sets no password.
exactly the configured number of rows is accepted for processing; one more is TOO_MANY_ROWS. Exactly the configured byte size is accepted; one byte more is FILE_TOO_LARGE.
verdicts.missing: The production byte and row limits are unset. Five rows is a test setting.

verdicts.quote: EMPTY_FILE | 0 bytes … NO_DATA_ROWS | header only … A single-row file creates 1.
re-submitting a file that already completed gives REJECTED with EMAIL_EXISTS for every row and creates nothing.
Choose a durable background job only if G-4 and G-5 show that it does not fit. A job requires a durable operation record, an owner for abandoned work, an authorized status lookup
verdicts.missing: The switch to background processing is conditional. The file size or row count that triggers it and how the admin sees completion after leaving the request are undecided.

verdicts.quote: Import sends no email and sets no password.
Import sends no email and sets no password. … the sign-in outcome for created users is not specified until the onboarding decision.
verdicts.missing: The initial account status (active or pending) and the first sign-in procedure remain unspecified.

verdicts.quote: Uploaded file | request memory or temp | the import code only | each request has its own copy | request end
acting admin id, timestamp, outcome (COMPLETED, REJECTED, IMPORT_FAILED), counts (rows read, users created, errors) and the file-level or row-level error codes with their counts.
the operation has no user cancel and a client disconnect does not stop a commit already begun … the file can be fixed and re-uploaded once.
verdicts.missing: Whole-file resubmission is described. The spec does not say whether the admin can select and retry just the rows named in the error report.

verdicts.quote: Activity is indeterminate unless real progress exists. … A numeric latency target for a file at the row limit is **unresolved**
verdicts.missing: The screen shows activity, but the maximum elapsed time for a maximum-size import is undecided.

verdicts.quote: Each created user is indistinguishable from a user created singly by an admin … Creating users does not touch existing users' data.
verdicts.missing: Record parity and preservation of existing users are specified. There is no requirement to preserve the manual creation workflow and its behavior.

verdicts.quote: Because the product offers no CSV download of results, no formula-injection escaping applies today. … a 254-character valid email is accepted and 255 is INVALID_EMAIL. … The name length limit is unresolved (G-7).
verdicts.missing: The spec resolves formula handling and email length. It leaves the maximum name length and the outcome for an overlong name undecided.
